title: Reach a key square
summary: A pawn on e3 wins if your king reaches d5, e5 or f5. Get there before you push the pawn.
hint: Ke5 or Kd5 steps straight onto a key square. Kc5 lets Black take the opposition and draw.

title: King on the sixth
summary: With your king on the sixth rank in front of a non-rook pawn, the win is there whoever has the move.
hint: Step beside the pawn with Kd6 or Kf6, not back. After e6 and e7 your king covers the promotion square.

title: Take the opposition
summary: As the defender, stand directly in front of the enemy king with one square between you.
hint: Only Kd6 holds. Every other king move lets White walk onto a key square.

title: Sit in the corner
summary: A rook pawn cannot force the defending king out of the corner.
hint: Shuffle between h8, h7 and g8. Stalemate is your friend here.

title: Three-pawn breakthrough
summary: Three pawns against three, with both kings too far away. One pawn sacrifice decides it.
hint: Start with b6. After axb6 play c6, and after cxb6 play a6. One pawn gets through.

title: Lucena position
summary: Your king is shut in front of its own pawn. Build a bridge with the rook so it can step out.
hint: Check the enemy king further away, put the rook on the fourth rank, then walk your king out. The rook blocks the checks.

title: Philidor defence
summary: Keep your rook on the sixth rank so the enemy king cannot advance. Once the pawn moves to the sixth, drop to the back and check from behind.
hint: Stay on the sixth rank while the pawn is on e5. When e6 comes, go to the first or second rank and give checks from far away.

title: Queen mate
summary: Box the king against an edge with the queen, then bring your own king up to finish.
hint: Keep the queen a knight's move from the enemy king as it retreats. Watch for stalemate once it reaches the corner.

title: Rook mate
summary: Cut the board with the rook, bring your king opposite the enemy king, and push it back one rank at a time.
hint: Check only when the kings stand in opposition. Otherwise make a waiting move along the rank with the rook.

title: Two bishops mate
summary: Bishops side by side form a wall the king cannot cross. Drive it to a corner with your king's help.
hint: Keep the bishops next to each other and away from the enemy king. Mate comes in a corner, not on the edge.
